typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3b_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		origin as string,
		RangeGroup as string,
		Inventory as string,
		RangeValue as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter2a
fromtblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter2a sink(input(
		origin as string,
		RangeGroup as string,
		Inventory as string,
		RangeValue as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		origin,
		RangeGroup,
		Inventory,
		RangeValue),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3b_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3b
